title: Haiti: Salvador’s Bukele publishes video of attack on gang leader’s house
summary: Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele said Wednesday that his troops demolished the lavish home of a prominent gang leader in Haiti known as Jeff Gwo Lwa. "My gift to the Haitian people on the anniversary of the Battle of Vertières," Bukele wrote on X - referencing a 1803 battle critical in helping secure Haiti's independence from France.
